Welcome to a world where compassion meets science. I’m Dr. Nikita Maskey, a dedicated veterinarian committed to improving animal health, welfare, and productivity. On this channel, you’ll find practical veterinary insights, livestock management tips, disease prevention strategies, and real-life field experiences. Whether you're a farmer, student, or animal lover, this space is designed to educate, inspire, and empower you to care better for animals. 

Subscribe for smarter farming and better care.
